stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: He followed his usual morning route through the hutong.
items.sentenceZh: 他沿着平常的晨间路线穿过胡同。
items.scene: On an ordinary Beijing morning, an older man follows the familiar hutong path with his bicycle, greeting the same breakfast vendor and neighbors as doors open around him.
items.altText: 老人沿平常路线穿过晨间胡同

items.styleFamily: expressive but calm editorial gouache illustration
items.sentenceEn: He paused to control his anger before answering.
items.sentenceZh: 他在回答前停下来控制愤怒。
items.scene: After a spilled project scatters across a table, a visibly upset man steps back, closes his eyes, and breathes while a colleague waits calmly, showing anger being managed safely.
items.altText: 男子停下来平复愤怒后再回应

items.sentenceEn: Psychological support helped the survivors feel safe again.
items.sentenceZh: 心理支持帮助幸存者重新获得安全感。
items.scene: In a warm community room after a storm, a counselor listens to several adults and guides a grounding exercise, while blankets and tea create a calm secure setting without clinical labels.
items.altText: 心理支持帮助灾后人群恢复安全感

items.sentenceEn: Snow fell heavily throughout the mountain night.
items.sentenceZh: 山中整夜下着大雪。
items.scene: Thick snow falls heavily around a remote mountain cabin, rapidly covering trees, roof, and path while warm light shows travelers safely sheltered inside.
items.altText: 大雪整夜猛烈覆盖山间小屋

items.sentenceEn: Clouds drifted below the mountain peak at sunrise.
items.sentenceZh: 日出时云层漂浮在山峰下方。
items.scene: A Huangshan mountain peak rises sharply above a glowing sea of clouds at sunrise, with two tiny hikers on a safe overlook providing scale among wind-shaped pines.
items.altText: 黄山山峰在日出云海上高耸

items.sentenceEn: Approximately half the apples filled one basket.
items.sentenceZh: 大约一半的苹果装满了一个篮子。
items.scene: A farmer divides a large apple harvest into two nearly equal groups, with one wicker basket holding approximately half while the remaining apples lie beside it, no numbers or labels.
items.altText: 苹果大约一半装入一个篮子

items.sentenceEn: Increasing bicycle traffic encouraged the city to widen the lane.
items.sentenceZh: 日益增长的自行车流量促使城市拓宽车道。
items.scene: A city street transitions from a narrow crowded bicycle lane to a wider protected lane carrying more riders safely, with construction workers completing the barrier and no signs or arrows.
items.altText: 自行车流量增长促使城市拓宽车道

items.sentenceEn: The storm left the workshop in complete disorder.
items.sentenceZh: 暴风雨后工坊一片混乱。
items.scene: After wind bursts through an open workshop window, papers, thread, and lightweight tools lie scattered in disorder while two artisans begin sorting everything safely.
items.altText: 暴风雨把工坊吹得杂乱无序

items.sentenceEn: The retired missile is displayed safely in the aviation museum.
items.sentenceZh: 这枚退役导弹安全地陈列在航空博物馆。
items.scene: Inside an aviation museum, visitors examine a clearly decommissioned missile mounted horizontally on secure supports beside early aircraft, with removed panels visible and no launch or combat scene.
items.altText: 退役导弹在航空博物馆安全陈列

items.sentenceEn: The coach divided the practice time equally among four players.
items.sentenceZh: 教练把训练时间平均分给四名队员。
items.scene: A coach rotates four young adult players through the same training station, each receiving an equal turn while the others encourage them from one line, with no clocks or numbers.
items.altText: 教练让四名队员获得同等训练时间

items.sentenceEn: The glaze colors vary from pale blue to deep green.
items.sentenceZh: 釉色从淡蓝到深绿各不相同。
items.scene: A Chinese ceramic artist arranges a row of hand-thrown bowls whose glazes vary gradually from pale blue through turquoise to deep green under soft studio light.
items.altText: 陶瓷碗釉色从淡蓝变化到深绿

items.sentenceEn: The electrician connected the copper wire to the lamp.
items.sentenceZh: 电工把铜线连接到灯具上。
items.scene: At a powered-off workbench, a trained electrician uses insulated tools and complete gloved hands to connect a visible copper wire inside an open lamp base, with no sparks.
items.altText: 电工安全连接灯具中的铜线

items.sentenceEn: A round moon gate framed the flowering garden.
items.sentenceZh: 圆形月洞门框住了花园景色。
items.scene: A perfectly round moon gate in a classical Chinese garden frames layered peonies, bamboo, and a distant pavilion, while a visitor pauses just inside the circular opening.
items.altText: 圆形月洞门框住中式花园

items.sentenceEn: Fair distribution gave every village enough grain.
items.sentenceZh: 公平分配让每个村庄都有足够粮食。
items.scene: At a rural Chinese cooperative, workers divide sacks of grain into several equal cartloads for neighboring villages as representatives check the balanced portions together, with blank sacks.
items.altText: 合作社把粮食公平分配给各村

items.sentenceEn: Public transportation carried commuters across the city.
items.sentenceZh: 公共交通运送通勤者穿越城市。
items.scene: A connected city scene shows commuters boarding an accessible tram that links to buses and bicycles at a clean transit hub, with blank destination displays and no logos.
items.altText: 公共交通运送通勤者穿越城市

items.sentenceEn: Visitors entered the holy sanctuary in respectful silence.
items.sentenceZh: 访客安静而恭敬地进入神圣殿堂。
items.scene: People of varied ages enter an old candlelit sanctuary with respectful posture and quiet faces, leaving shoes and conversation outside while soft light fills the sacred central space.
items.altText: 访客安静进入神圣的古老殿堂

items.sentenceEn: The twin sisters chose different instruments for the concert.
items.sentenceZh: 双胞胎姐妹为音乐会选择了不同乐器。
items.scene: Two clearly related but individually styled twin sisters rehearse side by side, one playing violin and the other cello, with distinct clothing, hair, and expressions.
items.altText: 双胞胎姐妹演奏不同的乐器

items.meaningZh: 命令；指挥；控制；部队；司令部
items.sentenceEn: The fire chief took command of the rescue operation.
items.sentenceZh: 消防队长接管了救援行动的指挥。
items.scene: Outside a smoke-free damaged warehouse, a fire chief calmly takes command by assigning safe search, medical, and equipment teams with hand gestures and a blank site map.
items.altText: 消防队长指挥有序的救援行动

items.sentenceEn: The library gave the artist a commission for a mural.
items.sentenceZh: 图书馆委托艺术家创作一幅壁画。
items.scene: A librarian and mural artist shake hands beside a blank wall and a colorful scale model showing readers beneath trees, visually conveying a creative commission without contracts or text.
items.altText: 图书馆委托艺术家创作壁画

items.sentenceEn: Her modern interpretation gave the old opera new energy.
items.sentenceZh: 她的现代解读为古老戏曲注入新活力。
items.scene: On one stage, a Chinese opera performer combines traditional sleeve movements with a restrained contemporary set while older musicians and young viewers respond with surprised admiration.
items.altText: 演员用现代方式解读传统戏曲
